allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking keeps optimization attached to the structure of the whole system instead of chasing local improvement in isolation.
allies.source_quote: Systems Thinking: The entire discipline of systems thinking is oriented toward optimizing complex interactions.
allies.affinity_rationale: The 'entire discipline of systems thinking is oriented toward optimizing complex interactions' — systems thinking provides the holistic framework within which optimization operates on interrelationships.
allies.activation_condition: When optimization requires understanding the full system of interacting components rather than optimizing a single variable in isolation

allies.rationale_text: Constraints give optimization its real boundary conditions so the best option is defined by actual limits rather than by idealized freedom.
allies.source_quote: Works when constraints are real rather than decorative.
allies.affinity_rationale: Constraints define the solution space within which optimization operates — understanding cognitive limits (CLT), competitive boundaries (game theory), and structural boundaries shapes what optimal means.
allies.activation_condition: When optimization efforts need to respect real-world boundaries rather than pursuing theoretical optima that violate system constraints

allies.rationale_text: Leverage-points sharpen optimization by directing effort toward the few system moves that change the outcome most.
allies.source_quote: Optimization necessitates filtering out the nonessential to focus on the core leverage points.
allies.affinity_rationale: Leverage points identify where optimization effort should be focused for maximum impact — concentrating resources on high-sensitivity variables rather than distributing effort uniformly.
allies.activation_condition: When optimization resources are limited and need to be focused on the variables that produce the largest output change per unit of input

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias makes optimization feel rigorous while quietly protecting the current objective, proxy, or favored frame from real challenge.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Team members may feel pressure to confirm the optimization hypothesis rather than challenging it skeptically — optimization targets become self-confirming.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the optimization target has been set and the team selectively gathers evidence that the current approach is optimal while ignoring signs of suboptimality

antagonists.rationale_text: Risk-vs-uncertainty pushes back when optimization language pretends the problem is knowable enough for strict maximization instead of de-risking and resilience work.
antagonists.source_quote: The existence of Unknown Unknowns means optimization must shift to de-risking and resilience, rather than strict maximization.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: The model of Knowns and Unknowns 'introduces complexity that resists perfect optimization' — Unknown Unknowns mean optimization must shift to de-risking and resilience.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the optimization problem contains genuinely uncertain parameters that resist quantification, making precise optimization illusory and resilience more valuable

structured_tensions.tension_text: Optimization-theory conflicts with non-linear-dynamics when optimization assumes smooth response surfaces in systems with discontinuous phase transitions.
structured_tensions.source_quote: optimization-theory conflicts with non-linear-dynamics (non-linear dynamics) when optimization assumes smooth response surfaces in systems with discontinuous phase transitions.
